objective.en: Spot flash-flooded St. Louis streets after record overnight rain and guide rescuers fast.

sources.name: NASA GPM IMERG daily precipitation (via NASA GIBS)
sources.usage: Observed rainfall, 25-28 Jul 2022 (26 July 2022 St. Louis flash flood). Flood cells are a heavy-rain PROXY, not mapped flood water: the wettest 35% of populated cells by IMERG event total (at least 131 mm). eventDay is the day a cell's cumulative IMERG rain first reached half its event total (mission day 0 = 2022-07-26; earlier lead-in rain counts as day 0).

sources.name: NASA SEDAC Gridded Population of the World v4, 2020 density (via NASA GIBS)
sources.usage: Cells with at least 500 people per square kilometre count as populated neighbourhoods.

sources.name: NASA MODIS NRT Global Flood Product, 2-day composite (via NASA GIBS)
sources.usage: Checked for observed flood water but no usable flood pixels were recorded. Checks: 2022-07-25 77% no-data, 0.0% flood; 2022-07-26 100% no-data, 0.0% flood; 2022-07-27 100% no-data, 0.0% flood; 2022-07-28 100% no-data, 0.0% flood.

sources.name: Cloud cover and sensor detectability (educational model)
sources.usage: Not observed: per-cell cloud probability is a model (storm-cloud base, higher where IMERG rain was heavier) and detectability is a seeded model. The heavy-rain-to-flood rule is also a simplification.
